title: EasyServer
description: Easily customize join, quit, and death messages with simple in-game commands.

A lightweight, all-in-one server management plugin designed to make server administration easier.
Currently features customizable player messages, with more essential tools coming soon!

Current Features

💬 Customizable Messages
Fully customize join, quit, and death messages to match your server’s style.
Change messages directly in-game with simple commands — no file editing required!

🎨 Color Code Support
Full support for Minecraft color codes using &. Create colorful, eye-catching messages.

Colors: &0–9, &a–f

Formatting: &l (bold), &n (underline), &o (italic)

🔧 Individual Control
Enable or disable each message type independently.

⚡ Lightweight & Fast
Minimal performance impact. Works seamlessly with other plugins.

Commands
/message set <join|quit|death> <message>


Set a custom message for join, quit, or death events.

/message enable <join|quit|death>


Enable messages for

/message disable <join|quit|death>
